name: popcorn-queue
description: A TypeScript PTP upload queue, browser bridge, and rule checker.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/core run build && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/integrations run build && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/worker run build && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/api run build && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/web run build
scripts.logs:job: sh -c 'if [ -n "$1" ]; then tail -f "data/jobs/$1/logs/job.log"; else find data/jobs -path "*/logs/job.log" -print 2>/dev/null || true; fi' --
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/core run typecheck && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/core run build && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/integrations run typecheck && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/integrations run build && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/api run typecheck && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/web run typecheck && npm --workspace @popcorn-queue/worker run typecheck
